activity.overview: Draw and name the parts of geometry, and connect angles to turns in a circle.

problems.prompt: Draw and label a point, a line segment, a line and a ray. How is a ray different from a line?
Draw a right angle, an acute angle and an obtuse angle. Label each one.
Draw a pair of parallel lines and a pair of perpendicular lines. Explain the difference.
An angle that turns through 1/360 of a circle measures 1 degree. How many degrees is an angle that turns through 1/4 of a circle?
How many degrees is an angle that turns through 1/2 of a circle?
The minute hand of a clock turns from the 12 to the 3. What kind of angle does it turn through, and how many degrees is it?
Find something in the classroom that has a right angle and something that has parallel lines. Describe each.

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: Points, Lines, Rays and Angles
